subject: Workplace Skills
title: Making Your Boss Your Sponsor
description: A quick, practical guide to Making Your Boss Your Sponsor.

hook.text: Research shows sponsorship is the number one predictor of career advancement, more than skill or performance alone.

buildup.text: A mentor gives advice. A sponsor puts their reputation on the line to advocate for you in rooms you are not in.

discovery.text: Your boss is your most natural potential sponsor. They see your work daily and have influence over your next role.

twist.text: Sponsors need to feel confident betting on you. Reliability, visibility, and results are the prerequisites.

climax.text: Make it easy by saying: 'I would love to be considered for X. What would I need to demonstrate for your support?'

punchline.text: Earn sponsorship through results. Then ask for it.

quiz.question: What is the difference between a mentor and a sponsor?
options: Mentors are always more senior than sponsors
Sponsors actively advocate for you in rooms you are not in
Mentors have more influence over hiring decisions
